evidence.description: JudgementResult matches REQ-003 exactly: verdict:bool required (raises via from_dict on missing key, gig_judge.py:47-48), reasoning/failure_reason default None, impossible_task/reached_captcha default False.

11/11 new-feature node:test assertions green, 21/21 plain-assert python checks green, pre-existing baseline failure (strategy.default.json max_apply cap) independently confirmed pre-dating this feature.

Clean purity/effect separation matching verification-architecture.md's Purity Boundary Map: gig_judge.py is a small, single-purpose pure module (150 lines); no duplication with gig_reality_verify.sh observed.

Clear stage structure (collect claims -> build prompt -> spawn judge -> parse -> record/selfheal), stdout-JSON-only discipline verified line-by-line (every diagnostic echo redirected >&2; only final JSON rows hit real stdout, each early-exit path exits immediately after its single stdout echo).

Diff against live main-repo version confirmed strictly additive (gig_reality_verify.sh appended to FILES array only); scan patterns independently checked against gig_reality_verify.sh source, no false-negative blind spot found.
